summary: Implement config-driven Minimum, Standard, and Premium plans for monthly/yearly billing, entitlements, usage, members, accounts, and locked UI states.
decisions: Plan IDs are minimum, standard, and premium with month/year intervals.
Prices, AI allowances, consultation estimates, and annual discount stay configuration-driven until approved.
Unavailable features remain visible with lock and upgrade guidance.
requirementRefs: DESIGN.md#4-ロックとアップグレード

risks.description: UI, API, Stripe Price, and DB entitlements may disagree.
risks.mitigation: Map six approved server-side Price entries from one versioned configuration and fail closed on unknown Price.

risks.description: Internal token or cost fields may leak to the browser.
risks.mitigation: Expose only credit usage, remaining consultation estimate, and reset date.

gates.description: Approve six prices, AI allowances, consultation estimates, and annual discount after cost measurement.
Approve Stripe test catalog, Portal, and webhook configuration.

acceptanceCriteria: The public plan endpoint never returns Price IDs or secrets.
Unknown or unpaid subscriptions fail closed.
Member, ad-account, chat, and write limits are enforced server-side; member/account limits also have DB enforcement.
Downgrade preserves existing rows and rejects only new over-limit additions.
Customer UI never shows tokens or internal cost.
Pricing remains configuration-driven until the approval gate is satisfied.

rollback.strategy: Disable the affected Stripe Price mapping and preserve subscription/data rows; revert UI availability without deleting customer data.
rollback.verification: Unknown/disabled Prices fail closed and existing workspace data remains readable under the documented billing gate.
